# AzureEnterprise.Tables

```m
AzureEnterprise.Tables(url as text) as table
```

Returns a list of reports and months available from the Azure Enterprise API

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Optional |
|---|---|---|
| `url` | `text` | no |
